headline: Hacked Flock camera reveals scale of its surveillance data
summary: Three outlets report that a hacking group extracted data from a Flock camera, finding it had captured 1.6 million images in 21 days and could detect people as well as vehicles. One outlet also reports that encryption keys were stored on the device despite the company's denials.
